asks: What do these words for the boundary mean: allow, hold, deny, ask, secret?
answer: Allow, hold and deny are the three things that can happen to a request waiting at the boundary: it passes, it waits for your answer, or it is refused as denied. An ask is what a hold shows you. A secret is a value a computer can use and cannot read. Boundary and channel keep the meanings in force.

sets.means: What happens to one request waiting at the boundary: it passes.
What happens to one request waiting at the boundary: it waits for your answer.
What happens to one request waiting at the boundary: it is refused, and what comes back says denied.
What a hold shows you: a request that waits for your answer.
A value a computer can use and cannot read.

suggest.why: The word is agreed; this meaning comes from the word list of the old design document, which carries no mark.
